summary:
Same result as validate attempt 1, and for the same reason. This attempt ran at the same HEAD (eafb1c3), and neither src nor tests have changed since attempt 1.

The one positive proof on a real stall is still unrun. The permission classifier again refused `WindowCases.ps1 -Case N-001 -IncludeNetwork` as "Modify Shared Resources", because the run creates and removes an SMB client mapping. That leaves N-001 to N-004 and the SMB-LOOPBACK StalledShareTests unrun:
- nobody has seen the wait line appear, count to about 60 s and clear through a real SMB stall;
- the Cancel-to-return time through the app is not recorded;
- closing the window during a real stall is unproven.

No named elevated operation reaches this. Only a person can: either run the command or allow SMB-mapping changes for this stage.

**What I re-ran this attempt**
- **Build:** 0 warnings, 0 errors.
- **Default suite:** 149/149 passed.
- **This slice's new tests:** 29/29 passed, including every StoppingWait boundary: -5 s, -1 ms, 0, 1.999 s, 2 s, 89.999 s, 90 s and 3600 s.
- **Fitness:** all 25 rules hold after a CodeGraph rebuild.
- **Default window run:** all 15 cases passed. In C-006 the scan returned 12 ms after Cancel, no stopping line showed the wait text, and a final line was written at shutdown.

I also re-read the src diff. The stopping clock is started only in OnCancel. The line is derived from that clock alone on the existing 250 ms tick. EndStopping sits in StartScan's single finally, and nothing abandons the scan.

**Carried from attempt 1, not re-run**
Attempt 1 ran scratch-hook probes against the published exe at this same HEAD, holding the cancel back on C:\Windows so the scan stayed running:
- The line showed at 2.0-2.2 s with the pinned wording.
- The UI never went more than 720 ms without a tick.
- The line cleared at return in both the Cancelled and the finished-on-its-own shapes.
- A new scan after such a cancel was clean.
- Closing with the line on screen ended the process within 39-85 ms.
- The committed hook refused after 60 s when the armed marker never appeared.

**An unexplained run in %TEMP%**
A WindowCases N-002 run happened at 07:43Z, after attempt 1 and outside this stage. Its leftovers are still in %TEMP% (fsa-window-cases\1eeab9e1... with rig\armed.txt, and hook log 837cee07....log). They show one "Close with no prior Cancel" shape: close acted 3002 ms after the stall armed, and the window closed 7 ms later. It was interrupted: the log was never cleaned up and there is no process-exit time. I can't say who ran it, so I record it only as an observation, not as a pass. I left the files in place. A follow-up read of the event log was refused by the permission layer, so I did not pursue it.

**Still open**
- C2, the person's own acceptance of option (b).
- O-001's real disconnects.
- The faulted ending.
- The 90 s wording shown in the real window.

**This stage is going round in circles**
Validate attempts 1 and 2 ran at the same HEAD and hit the same permission wall. A third attempt will produce this same answer unless a person first does one of three things:
- runs `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case All -IncludeNetwork` themselves;
- allows that action for this stage;
- accepts the slice without N-001.

Also passed: TheGateIsExactlyTwoSeconds, ANegativeSpanShowsNothing, TheSecondsAreFloored and TheTextIsAsciiAndGivesNoBoundOnTheWait. Its checks held: the scan returned within 2 s, no stopping line showed the wait line, and every stopping line had the title Stopping.... NOT RUN: N-001, N-002, N-003, N-004.

checks.evidence: Refused by the Claude Code auto-mode classifier, reason [Modify Shared Resources]. This is the same refusal attempt 1 got. The command never started, and per the denial I did not pursue the same outcome another way.

It makes the same SMB mapping change, so it falls under the same denial. It compiles, and has never run since the rig moved into Rig/SmbRig.cs.

checks.what: Leftovers of a WindowCases network run made outside this stage
checks.command: Get-ChildItem %TEMP%\fsa-window-cases, %TEMP%\fsa-window-hook; Get-Content of the newest hook log
checks.evidence: Observation only, not graded. A case folder 1eeab9e15e3049d28ca94503a91d2267\rig\armed.txt and hook log 837cee07261147c7847b290ffde81a12.log are dated 13:13 local (07:43Z). That is after attempt 1 (07:22Z) and before this attempt. The log reads: 'loaded mode=close', 'armed ms=428', 'acted mode=close scanning=True detail=- ms=3431 sincearmed=3002', 'closed ms=3438'. That is N-002's 'Close with no prior Cancel' shape, with the window closed 7 ms after Close. The log was not removed by Invoke-WithHook's finally and the case folder was not removed, so the run was interrupted. No process-exit time exists. Who ran it is unknown. A follow-up read of the Application event log was refused by the permission classifier and not pursued. The files are left in place.

checks.command: git status --short; Get-SmbMapping; Get-Process FsAnalyser.App, StallRig
checks.evidence: The worktree shows only the pre-existing .taad changes. The only mapping is Z: -> \\100.109.48.75\collab (OK), and no FsAnalyser.App or StallRig process is running.

checks.what: Read the src change: clock start, tick derivation, EndStopping placement, no abandon
checks.evidence: _stoppingClock = Stopwatch.StartNew() only in OnCancel. The tick handler calls ShowProgress() then ShowStopping(), which uses only StoppingWait.For(clock.Elapsed). EndStopping() is in StartScan's finally, after _timer.Stop() and before ScanningPanel collapses. StoppingWait.For is a pure function: null under 2 s, the 'minute or more' wording under 90 s, no estimate from 90 s, seconds floored.

MarkerDeadline = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60) (:57). At :196 the hook logs 'refused mode=... reason=the rig's marker ... did not appear within 60 s, so the stall never armed'. UI reads go through app.Dispatcher.Invoke (:154, :256) and ShutdownStarted (:339).

checks.what: Local analogue probes through the real exe (scratch hook holding the cancel back on C:\Windows): wait line, finished-on-its-own, new scan after, close with the line up, close without Cancel, missing marker
checks.command: validate attempt 1 scratch run.ps1 / close.ps1; not re-run
checks.evidence: From validate attempt 1 at the same HEAD eafb1c3, with no src or tests change since. Not re-run in this attempt. Cancel held back 6 s: first line at 2153 ms, 14 lines, 0 wording violations, longest gap 493 ms, cleared at return, Cancelled. Cancel never delivered: first line at 2032 ms, 100 lines to 31 s, longest gap 720 ms, cleared at return, Completed. New scan after: 16 ticks all 'Reading ...' with detail '-'. Close with the line up: window 8 ms, process 39 ms. Close without Cancel: 12 ms and 85 ms. Missing marker: refused after 60 s.

checks.what: Faulted ending while the Stopping state shows
checks.evidence: No seam makes Scanner.Scan throw after Cancel, and the SL-033 rule forbids adding one. It rests on reading the single finally.

checks.what: 90 s no-estimate wording rendered in the real window
checks.evidence: Nothing reachable keeps a scan running more than 90 s after Cancel without an SMB stall or reading the person's own folders. It is pinned only by the unit tests.

checks.what: Real disconnects: Wi-Fi off, tailscale down, sleep about 2 min mid-scan, 3 runs each plus one timed Close per mode (O-001)
checks.evidence: Changing network state or sleeping the PC is forbidden to this stage. Spike real-disconnect-wait-matches-rig also recorded 0 of 9. Only the person can run these.

checks.what: Loop check on the slice index
checks.evidence: This is a slice-shape finding, not a code failure. Validate attempt 1 ('waiting') and this attempt 2 ran at the same HEAD eafb1c3 with nothing changed in between, and both were blocked by the same permission refusal on SMB mapping changes. Another validate lap without a person's action will return the same answer. No other stage has more than one attempt, and caused_by is null throughout.

criteria.criterion: 1. cancel a scan -- local tree, the scan returns within 2 s of Cancel
criteria.how: This attempt's C-006 through the published exe: 'returned ms=12', no wait line on any stopping line, final line at shutdown with detail '-', PASSED.

criteria.criterion: 2. cancel a scan of a stalled SMB share -- session established, server stops answering, Cancel pressed 3 s after the stall is armed
criteria.how: N-001 -IncludeNetwork was refused by the permission classifier in this attempt too. The only evidence is the local analogue from attempt 1, where the scan thread was never blocked in an SMB call.

criteria.criterion: 3. the stalled scan finally returns -- when the SMB client gives up (about 57-66 s on the rig)
criteria.how: No SMB run happened, so the Cancel-to-return time through the app is unrecorded. The 57-66 s range comes from spike 1 and the C1 baseline.

criteria.criterion: 4. choose the wording for an elapsed time -- 1.999 s, 2.0 s, 89.999 s, 90 s, negative TimeSpan
criteria.how: StoppingWaitTests passed this attempt at every boundary (-5000, -1, 0, 1999, 2000, 89999, 90000 and 3600000 ms) and in the one-tick and flooring facts. The 90 s branch was never rendered in the real window.

criteria.criterion: 5. close the window while the wait line is shown -- stalled share, Cancel then Close, and Close with no prior Cancel
criteria.how: N-002 on a real stall was not run by this stage (denied). Attempt 1's local analogue passed: window gone in 8 and 12 ms, process in 39 and 85 ms. An unattributed, interrupted N-002 run in %TEMP% shows only the no-Cancel shape's window closing 7 ms after Close, with no process-exit time, so it is not counted.

criteria.criterion: 6. scan ends while the Stopping state is showing -- cancelled cleanly, faulted, or finished on its own before the cancel took effect
criteria.how: Cancelled-cleanly with the line shown and finished-on-its-own were both fed through the real exe in attempt 1, and the line cleared at return each time. The faulted shape is fed by nothing: there is no seam, and SL-033 forbids adding one.

criteria.criterion: 7. run the stall rig -- another run's fsa<8hex> mapping already exists (two rig runs at once)
criteria.how: N-003 and N-004 were refused. SmbRigTests passed this attempt: lock serialisation, a killed holder not blocking the next run, and the exact-match sweep regex. No real mapping was made.

criteria.criterion: 8. start a new scan after a stalled cancel -- previous scan ended after the wait line had been shown
criteria.how: Attempt 1, same HEAD: after a held-back local cancel whose line showed from 2.0 to 4.9 s, a second scan showed 'Reading ...', detail '-' and Cancel enabled on all 16 ticks. The earlier stall was local and synthetic, not SMB. Not re-run in this attempt.

criteria.criterion: 9. show the wait line for a local drive that stalls -- spun-down local disk taking more than 2 s to cancel
criteria.how: Attempt 1, same HEAD: on C:\Windows, with the cancel taking more than 2 s, the real window showed the pinned wording at 2.0-2.2 s. This attempt's diff read confirms the line comes from the clock alone, so it does not depend on the drive type. A real spun-down disk was not reached.

criteria.criterion: 10. the hook reads UI text -- read from the hook's own thread instead of the UI thread
criteria.how: StartupHook.cs does every UI read through app.Dispatcher.Invoke (:154, :256), the Dispatcher timer or ShutdownStarted (:339). This attempt's hooked runs (C-006, C-012, O-016) logged no refusal after acting.

criteria.criterion: 11. the wait on a real disconnect -- Wi-Fi off, tailscale down, sleep and resume mid-scan
criteria.how: Forbidden to this stage. O-001 is still owed and only the person can run it.

criteria.criterion: 12. the hook waits for the armed marker -- marker never appears before the case timeout
criteria.how: Attempt 1 ran the committed hook with a missing marker: it logged the refusal after 60 s and pressed nothing. This attempt re-read the code path (StartupHook.cs:57, :196) but did not re-run it.

obligations.evidence: The real-disconnect protocol (Wi-Fi off, tailscale down, sleep about 2 min, 3 runs each, plus a timed Close per mode) needs the person's network state changed or the PC slept, and both are forbidden to this stage. 'A minute or more' still rests only on the loopback rig and SessionTimeout 60. It remains owed to a person.

This one is owed to build-slice, not to validate. For the record: attempt 1 fed the finished-on-its-own and cancelled-with-line-shown shapes through the real exe, and both cleared at return. The faulted shape is still fed by nothing. The rig-based cancelled-cleanly proof (N-001) is still unrun because of the permission denial.

not_reached: N-001 on a real SMB stall: the wait line appearing 1.9-3 s after Cancel, counting to about 60 s with the UI live, and clearing at return, plus the measured Cancel-to-return time. The permission classifier refused it twice ([Modify Shared Resources]). A person needs to run `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case All -IncludeNetwork` or allow it for this stage.

N-002 on the stalled share: that the process ends within 5 s of Close while the scan thread is blocked in an SMB kernel call. An unattributed, interrupted run in %TEMP% shows only the window half of one shape.
N-003 and N-004 with real mappings: RigLock serialising two rig runs on 127.0.0.1, and the sweep removing a killed run's leftover mapping.
StalledShareTests (Network=SMB-LOOPBACK) after the rig moved into Rig/SmbRig.cs. It compiles but has never run since.
O-001: timed real disconnects (Wi-Fi off, tailscale down, sleep and resume), including one timed Close per mode.
The 90 s no-estimate wording rendered in the real window. Only the unit tests pin it.
The faulted ending while the Stopping state shows.
A real spun-down local disk. The local stall evidence is synthetic (cancel held back).
The person's own acceptance of option (b) (C2). O-002 was discharged with model contact, not by the person.
RigLock's Local\ (per-session) mutex: two rig runs from different sign-in sessions are not serialised, and this is untested.
